# FluexGL Docs

> Documentation for FluexGL (WebGPU graphics, in development) and FluexGL DSP (@fluex/fluexgl-dsp), a channel-based web audio engine with Rust/WebAssembly AudioWorklet effects, native compressor/limiter effects, and a 2D/3D spatial audio system with distance attenuation, air absorption, reverb sends and source clustering, input devices (microphones, WebRTC streams) and runtime switching of input and output devices.

Start with the AI guide: it contains the mental model, the API quick reference, the conventions and the common pitfalls on one page.

## Start here
- [AI guide](FluexGL%20DSP/AI-GUIDE.md): mental model, API quick reference, conventions, pitfalls
- [Getting started](Getting%20started/How%20to%20use%20FluexGL-DSP.md): installation and pipeline initialization
- [Spatial audio](Getting%20started/Spatial%20audio.md): concepts of the 2D/3D spatial audio system

## Effects
- [Compressor](FluexGL%20DSP/effects/Compressor.md), [Limiter](FluexGL%20DSP/effects/Limiter.md), [MultibandCompressor](FluexGL%20DSP/effects/MultibandCompressor.md), [StereoPanner](FluexGL%20DSP/effects/StereoPanner.md), [StereoMono](FluexGL%20DSP/effects/StereoMono.md): native, no WASM needed
- [Equalizer](FluexGL%20DSP/effects/Equalizer.md), [Saturation](FluexGL%20DSP/effects/Saturation.md): AudioWorklet/WASM
- [MonoDelay](FluexGL%20DSP/effects/MonoDelay.md), [StereoDelay](FluexGL%20DSP/effects/StereoDelay.md), [PingPongDelay](FluexGL%20DSP/effects/PingPongDelay.md), [AdvancedDelay](FluexGL%20DSP/effects/AdvancedDelay.md): AudioWorklet/WASM, shared delay engine
- [Reverb](FluexGL%20DSP/effects/Reverb.md), [LowPassFilter](FluexGL%20DSP/effects/LowPassFilter.md), [HighPassFilter](FluexGL%20DSP/effects/HighPassFilter.md), [Chorus](FluexGL%20DSP/effects/Chorus.md), [SoftClip](FluexGL%20DSP/effects/SoftClip.md), [HardClip](FluexGL%20DSP/effects/HardClip.md): AudioWorklet

## Optional
- [Interfaces and types](FluexGL%20DSP/interfaces/): option objects such as SpatialAudioRendererOptions, SpatialClusteringOptions, CompressorOptions, LimiterOptions
- [Helpers](FluexGL%20DSP/helpers/): loadAudioSource, listAudioInputDevices, listAudioOutputDevices, watchAudioDevices, hasInitializedWasm and others
- [Tips](Tips/): strict mode, multiple audio buffer sources
